visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young Asian man with short dark hair, wearing a blue and grey plaid shirt over a dark top, addresses the camera in a selfie-perspective. He smiles and gestures with his hands while yellow subtitles appear at the bottom. The background shows a busy urban street with pedestrians and storefronts under natural daylight. (2) The scene shifts to the area under a large concrete flyover bridge. Numerous red banners with Traditional Chinese text and small altars with fruit offerings are visible. A close-up shows a hand gripping a brown high-heeled shoe, repeatedly striking a small white paper cutout placed on a rectangular red brick. (3) The man is seen sitting at a small table covered with a yellow patterned cloth. Opposite him sits an elderly woman wearing a white sweatshirt with the word 'WAKE' and a blue surgical mask. She is focused on writing on red paper strips and arranging paper talismans. Smoke from incense sticks rises in the background. (4) Various close-up shots show the practitioner's hands handling and presenting different ritual items: stacks of yellow paper with red printed motifs, green slips, and small booklets. The man holds up a red packet featuring gold foil '招財進寶' characters and a red paper illustration toward the camera, speaking directly to the lens. (5) Final shot of the man nodding and speaking in a selfie-shot with the flyover columns and red ritual banners still visible behind him, maintaining a friendly facial expression.

A male voice speaks with high energy and rapid delivery in Mandarin, introducing the location. Low-level ambient city hum is barely audible. (2) A series of rhythmic, percussive thudding sounds occur as a shoe strikes a surface. These impact sounds have a narrow bandwidth and are synchronized with the visual action. The male narrator maintains a constant, enthusiastic vocal presence. (3) The narrator's pitch variability increases as he describes a personal revelation, his tone becoming more hushed and confidential to signal a change in the narrative's emotional weight. (4) A brief interaction occurs where a mature female voice is heard with clear articulation, naming specific items in a neutral, informative tone. (5) The male narrator returns to a high-arousal, upbeat tone for his final recommendation, with the music track continuing steadily until the end of the clip.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Contextual Introduction -> Detailed Experience -> Climax/Revelation -> Final Recommendation
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents the creator's visit to the traditional 'Villain Hitting' ritual under the Canal Road Flyover in Hong Kong. It aims to share the cultural curiosity of the event, detail the associated costs and 'add-on' services, and emphasize the surprising accuracy of the practitioner's insights to intrigue and advise future travelers.
